body:
Please report the Pygments advisory to Pygments; the other entry concerns Requests, whose advisory says standard Requests usage is not affected. Rich lists Pygments as a runtime dependency, while Requests is not among its declared runtime dependencies. For private vulnerability reports, see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
